title: Name a practice container
summary: A container name gives you a clear target for later inspection. The -d option runs it in the background.
introduction: A container name gives you a clear target for later inspection. The -d option runs it in the background. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: A container name gives you a clear target for later inspection. The -d option runs it in the background.
The container starts a local web server. Port 8080 on the local machine forwards to port 80 in the container.

items: Read the example from top to bottom. Point to the part that uses the new idea.
Open localhost:8080 on the same machine if you chose to run the example.
Explain what changed in your own words. Check the example again if you get stuck.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: Use a fresh name and bind practice ports to 127.0.0.1 so they are not exposed on every network interface.
For more detail later, use this [Docker further reading](https://docs.docker.com/get-started/).

seo.title: Docker: Name a practice container
seo.description: Learn about name a practice container in Docker. Follow a small example, understand the result, and practise with a clear question.
